blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY—The National Police Commission (Napolcom) on Wednesday ordered the dismissal of the police officer whose gun was used by her nephew in the deadly attack at San Jose National High School here. Ordered dismissed from the service is Police Staff Sergeant Arla Ray O. Paciencia of the Regional Finance Service Unit 8 in Eastern Visayas for committing lapses that led to her issued firearm being used by her 14-year-old nephew. Napolcom said it found Paciencia guilty of grave misconduct and conduct unbecoming of a police officer in relation to the June 22, 2026 incident that left three students dead and several […]...
